name: SMACS J0516.5-5431 (Hubble)
blurb: SMACS J0516.5-5431, a galaxy cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: smacsj051655431-hubble
story: SMACS J0516.5-5431 is a rich, X-ray bright galaxy cluster, a great city of galaxies. Hubble took a quick snapshot to see whether its gravity bends and magnifies the light of galaxies far behind it.

claims.text: SMACS J0516.5-5431 (SMACSJ0516.5-5431) is a massive galaxy cluster targeted by Hubble program 16670
Hubble program 16670 is a snapshot survey of extreme, X-ray luminous galaxy clusters, seeking powerful gravitational telescopes
The program studies dark and luminous matter in cluster cores
